provenance.downloaded_at_basis: filesystem mtime of data/raw/hotpot_dev_distractor_v1.json; the download predates provenance recording, so this is the write time of the file, not an independently logged download timestamp
provenance.official_source_status: unreachable on 2026-09-12 (TCP timeout on ports 443 and 80); not used
provenance.provenance_basis: recorded retrospectively during stage 3 from the stage-2 preparation run of 2026-09-12, whose report named this mirror as source_url_used; the file itself was not re-downloaded to confirm this

checked: first 3 records match on _id, question, answer, type, level
verification.method: partial comparison against the official HuggingFace mirror of the same split (hotpotqa/hotpot_qa, config distractor, split validation)
verification.scope: PARTIAL - not a record-by-record comparison of the whole file; the dataset publishes no official checksum, so full identity with the original CMU file is not established

selection_algorithm: keep structurally valid records; sort by question id; shuffle with random.Random(seed); take the first pilot_size
sha256_note: Self-computed SHA-256 of the local file. It proves the file is identical between runs; it is not a match against an official published checksum, because the dataset publishes none.
